name: enrich-contact-records
description: Enrich Notion contact records with person profile data via a three-source cascade: Lusha first (search_and_enrich_contacts resolves the id, enrich_contacts reveals emails only — no phone credits), then Apollo people/match, then NinjaPear. An enriched work address takes Primary Email when the existing Primary is a consumer mailbox; a corporate Primary is treated as curated and left alone. Addresses compare case-insensitively, name falls back to the page title, and the outcome comment names each failed source separately. Empty webhook pings (URL tests) are skipped without raising. NinjaPear is never queried with a personal email and is gated on domain + name.
